rationale: The task is a narrowly bounded documentation-only correction: adding the missing agdf/ directory entry to the README project tree. decision_grounds: The requested diff is confined to README documentation.
The change only restores a missing project-tree entry and does not alter user-visible behavior, product semantics, gates
policy, persistence, architecture, runtime, or release behavior.
The canonical modes contract permits a quick_task fully outside plugin/skills/**, plugin/control/templates/**, plugin
/meta/**, create-agdf/lib/**, create-agdf/bin/**, and executable code to close under the Trivial Change Boundary.
No approved UR or Brownfield decision is required to classify this fresh ungated trivial documentation change; compact
